scenarios.unite: valeur du portefeuille simulé (en CAD), capital de départ 10000
scenarios.formule: rendements mensuels observés du portefeuille, tirés au hasard avec remise ; valeur = capital × ∏(1 + rendement mensuel tiré) ; centiles 10, 25, 50, 75, 90 par année

hypotheses: Constant weights, no fees, no taxes, no inflation.
Future months resemble the observed months and are independent of one another.
The range inherits the average return of the observed window, which may not repeat.
details.avertissement: This is not a forecast. The range is based on only 61 observed months: future outcomes may fall outside it, higher or lower.

scenarios.unite_en: simulated portfolio value (in CAD), starting capital 10000
scenarios.formule_en: observed monthly returns of the portfolio, drawn at random with replacement ; value = capital × ∏(1 + drawn monthly return) ; percentiles 10, 25, 50, 75, 90 per year
